## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.4

- Stops static guide and continuation spines at separate list blocks when **Connect separate list blocks** is disabled, including blank-line-separated blocks.
- Adds **Thread separate list blocks that are only separated by a blank line** as a disabled-by-default opt-in beneath All Branches threading; nonblank content always remains a hard thread boundary.
- Adds enabled-by-default threading from an immediately preceding non-bulleted/numbered list head in Live Preview, Source mode, and Reading mode.
- Adds a global static-guide toggle above the three existing rendering-mode toggles in the new **List Static Tree Indentation Guides** settings section.
- Prevents transient stale or overdrawn guide geometry during scrolling by hiding the old frame immediately, bounding continuation spines to their block, and clamping inferred positions to the editor viewport.
- Adds individual enabled-by-default toggles for all eight list-thread colors, an enabled-by-default light/dark fallback color, and a disabled-by-default light/dark global override color in Style Settings.
- Retains searchable settings, precise synchronized Style Settings number fields, viewport-only rendering, pop-out support, and attested `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` release assets.
